hooks.command: cd /home/user/PMServer && git status --porcelain | grep -q . || exit 0; files=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null); git add -A && git commit -m "auto: $(echo \"$files\" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//')"
